newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SBI index falls for fifth session.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SBI index falls for fifth session.

text.p: Slovenia's SBI index extended losses for a fifth session on Wednesday as a rash of heavy selling in Kolinska more than wiped out strong gains in BTC.
Outlook for the market remains clouded by the issue of ratifying the EU association accord, traders said.
* The SBI index fell 0.45 percent or 5.85 points to 1,288.77.
* Kolinska was the most actively traded on turnover of 4,531 lots, falling 34 tolars to 1,862.
* Issue C of drug company Lek was the leading decliner, tumbling 7.37 percent to 22,510 tolars on volume of only one share.
* Brokerage Dadas was the top gainer, jumping 10.42 percent to 14,400 tolars on volume of 28 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
